question: Satwik starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards east. He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 6 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

 
• Satwik starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards east.
 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 6 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 4 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P.
